# Glass Almanac

> > Glass Almanac covers extended reality (XR), mixed reality headsets, and the intersection of emerging technologies with workforce transformation.

Glass Almanac provides analysis and news on XR hardware developments from major tech companies like Samsung, Apple, Meta, and Google, alongside commentary on AI's impact on employment and Silicon Valley trends. The site focuses on spatial computing, mixed reality platforms like Android XR, and the evolving relationship between technology and human work.
